ANSI float level switch nc symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for float level switch nc, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The float-operated NC form represents a normally continuous contact path influenced by liquid level. The level condition cannot be deduced from NC alone because the selected float arrangement establishes its operating direction.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Evaluate both rising and falling level conditions.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A closed reference contact does not automatically identify a low-level alarm.
